headline: Zale Parry, Aquatic Hollywood Star and Early Acid Tripper, Dies at 93
context: A diving feat landed her on the cover of Sports Illustrated and led to a film and TV career. She also took part in one of the first LSD studies.

sources.name: The New York Times
